verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 56.4 (-5.3% in a day) and momentum is 42: prices are falling. 84s cost 700, 85s 1,200 and 86s 3,200. It is Champions weekend, when meta cards usually sell best.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-11-28T07:48:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Fabinho 87 Ultimate Scream after its 45% jump, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 28,000 coins. Now 33,500. Sell the spike: a card that jumped in a day often gives part of the jump back within two days. Picked because it is up 45.5% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 10 of 19 so far, averaging +4.9% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Sell Salma Paralluelo 87 after its 47% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 19,000 coins. Now 14,250. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 47.2% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 16 of 26 so far, averaging +8.3% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Champions weekend: sell spare meta cards, keep the ones you play
moves.detail: Meta cards usually sell best during the weekend. Selling and rebuying cards you play costs the 5% tax and a higher weekend price.

moves.title: Fodder: 85s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 700 (0.84 coins per Item Score point), 85s 1,200 (0.57 coins per Item Score point), 86s 3,200 (0.78 coins per Item Score point), 87s 5,100 (0.93 coins per Item Score point), 88s 10,000 (1.20 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 85s then 86s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Kika Nazareth and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Kika Nazareth 86 Destined for Glory -59.5%; Jérémy Doku 87 UEFA Champions League RTTK -59.4%; Salma Paralluelo 87 Rare -58.4%; Micky van de Ven 81 Rare -57.3%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.
